description: This Java source file defines the 'AclInvalidException' class, which represents a specific type of runtime exception related to invalid Access Control Lists (ACLs) in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class includes constructors, static factory methods, a builder pattern for customization, and implements interfaces for exception handling and JSON parsing support. It is marked as deprecated and immutable.
